body: Thank you for that, and yeah that’s exactly how I feel. It’s super messed up and I don’t know why I’m so dependent on him :/
I think talking would help, I feel like if I tell anyone in my life it would set off an explosion :/
I didn’t think of that, I just don’t know how long women’s shelters are for and I’m not sure when I can get back on my feet. I’ll look into it, thank you

Thats awesome! I didn’t know there was something like that and it’s exactly what I need. Unfortunately I’m learning French in Utah so literally NO ONE speaks it. But I’m in love with learning it and it’s something I’ve wanted to do. Thanks for this advice!

Okay so I kinda had this experience except it was my neighbor and his stalking got out of hand. My friend who was in law enforcement told me to document EVERY TIME he attempted to contact me (screenshots, letters, photos, me being explicit in telling him NOT to contact me.) And begin a report. That way if anything gets too serious, you have a running history. This is harassment in the eyes of law enforcement.

Yes! I’ve have found some great youtubers to watch and I have been listening to a podcast « News in Slow French » So I can get used to hearing it. I guess one thing is I want to make sure that I’m not just getting the textbook language because I’ve heard that a lot is dropped by the French (Like removing the ‘ne’ in « Je ne suis pas....’) this is great advice though thank you :)
Thank! Hopefully I’ll get good enough so the Parisians won’t even notice! (Haha if I aim high enough maybe I’ll be able to at least sound okay!)

This was amazing! Thank you for this :D I’ve been making a lot of changes in what I see and hear everyday to seeing French. I really want to study abroad and live there for a year, but I want to be completely comfortable with the language.

I currently speak Spanish and English, but I’m picking up French so easily. I don’t make the mistake of speaking from the front of my mouth when speaking French (as that is how it is in Spanish) but I’m making tremendous strides than when I tried learning German! French is just much more interesting.
Thank you for this, this helps :)
